vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Elena taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
🛡️ Siobhan, Clarence, Joana and Aidan met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Clarence, Aidan are hurt.
Siobhan showed Ivy the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Elena drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
🛡️ Siobhan, Clarence, Ivy and Aki met them at the door — 4 put down. Siobhan, Clarence, Aki are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Wolfgang, Siobhan, Joana, Aidan and Zoe met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Wolfgang, Siobhan, Joana, Zoe are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateo just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder, weeks in the baskets. Handling it day after day, the village has learned what it's FOR — not just what it is. The village knows its uses now.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/2) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wolfgang just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

Your party: Wolfgang. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Loud-Eyes is still frozen from your scream.

📺 Wolfgang brought down Pack-leader Loud-Eyes, Loud-Eyes (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Wolfgang brought down Pack-leader Loud-Eyes, Loud-Eyes (packmate). Together.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
Wolfgang SCREAMS — a sound like milk curdling in fast-forward. Its focus shatters. The The Scarred The Redactor freezes. (stunned)
The Scarred The Redactor is still frozen from your scream.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)

📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred The Redactor!
📺 You brought down Scarred The Redactor. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
